title: Drunken Yacht Party Queen Battles Husband, Cops, & Self-Control!
description:
On August 4th, 2023, officers in Ohio received a call from concerned neighbors reporting a man and woman arguing, causing a disturbance on the road outside the neighborhood. The caller indicated the female involved was possibly under the influence of alcohol. Based on the report, officers arrived at the roadway and attempted to stabilize the situation. The officer spoke to the male, identified as the female's husband, who explained the couple’s argument to the officer. The female's husband took his wife’s keys and called his in-laws to drive his wife’s vehicle home, attempting to prevent her from driving under the influence.

The woman, showing signs of severe intoxication, spoke to the officers, explaining she had been at a yacht party earlier that night and became increasingly agitated with officers. The woman’s parents arrived to take her home as she continued shouting on the roadway. Both officers and her parents could not calm her down. The woman began exiting and re-entering her parent’s vehicle. While walking on the road, shouting, the woman eventually ran toward her husband, pushing and hitting him and striking an officer. 

Officers immediately arrested the suspect and transported her to the local police department for booking. She was uncooperative during the process, continuing her behavior. After declining medical treatment, the female suspect was charged with Disorderly Conduct.
